verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review platform, so official SDKs are a fair question. The evidence documents a REST API (Analytics and Members) with OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs, playground code examples, a CLI and an MCP server, but no official client library or SDK package. OpenAPI documents and code samples are developer building blocks for generating a client, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
